purpose: Teach: 一撃/行財政/主審/官民/裏づけ/等価/定型/総勢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界に一撃を与える論文を出せ
lines.en: Ren — produce a paper that makes an impact on the academic world.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Expectation, not suggestion. Slight pause after the name. Clear-eyed assessment of capability. Not unkind, but unambiguous.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。行財政学の新潮流を学びます
lines.en: Yes. I'll study the new currents in administrative and financial studies.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Slight lift at the end—commitment, not just compliance. Earnest but not eager. Takes the assignment seriously without overselling himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文発表の主審査を引き受けろ
lines.en: Ren — take on the main review role for the paper presentation.
lines.style: Flat directive. Pause after name. Assigning responsibility like handing over a tool. Expects he'll use it well. No cushioning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。官民連携研究にも参加します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also participate in the public-private partnership research.
lines.style: Steady acceptance. Small breath before 'also'—showing he's thinking about the scope. Measured delivery. Not pushing back, not overcommitting. Careful balance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、仮説には裏づけデータが必須だ
lines.en: Ren — your hypotheses need backing data. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, almost clinical tone. Weight on 'non-negotiable.' Not criticism—instruction. The voice of someone who's seen sloppy work and won't let it happen here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指標を等価に正規化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll normalize the indicators to equal weight.
lines.style: Precise, technical. Brief. Shows he understands the requirement and has already begun solving it. No wasted breath. Professional deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、定型の実験手順を覚えろ
lines.en: Ren — learn the standard experimental procedures inside out.
lines.style: Declarative. Slight emphasis on 'standard'—not creative improvisation. Practical instruction. The voice expecting mastery of fundamentals first.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。総勢三十名の研究室です
lines.en: Yes. We're a lab of thirty people total.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact closure. Small acknowledgment in the delivery—'we're thirty'—showing he's absorbed the scale of the team he's part of. Finality without abruptness.
